question: Can material wealth equal the value of the Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Someone may possess such an accumulation
This wealth is set up as a comparison
inference: Even an ocean full of jewels is implied to be insufficient compared to this teaching
uncertainties: The form akretuṃ is irregular and likely corrupt

plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation like an ocean filled with jewels...
